items.text: Odwe luka Isakar; Tola, ka Pua, ka Yasub, ka Simuron, iwonon.

Odwe luka Tola; Usi, ka Repaia, ka Yeriel, ka Yamai, ka Ibusam, ka Semuel, ikapolokitok luka ikekia luka lukapapaakec, kes luka Tola; ituŋa lukirigin Iuetitin katuriokec: etiaikec kapaarasia nuka Daudi emwaasi ilukumin akaisaarei ka luarei ka akwat akanykape.
Odwe luka Usi; Isirakia: odwe luka Isirakia; Mikael, ka Obadia, ka Yoel, ka Isia, ikany: kes kere ituŋa lukapolok.
Kojaas nepepe kakes, katuriokec, kwape ajaatar ikekia luka lukapapaakee, irioneta luka ajore ejie, ilukumin akaisauni ka ilukumin ikanykapc; naarai ajaas kes aŋor ka isap luipu.
Iinaeanakec kokekia kere luka Isakar, ituŋa lukirigin luetitin, kimarai kakere kauriokec, emwaasi ilukumin akaisakanykauni ka ilukumin ikanykaarei.
Odwe luka Benyamin: Bela, ka Beker, ka Yediael, iuni.

Odwe luka Bela; Esibon, ka Usi, ka Usiel, ka Yerimot, ka Iri, ikany; ikapolok luka ikekia luka lukapapaa, ituŋa lukirigin Iuetitiŋ; aponi kimarai kauriokee ilukumin akaisaarei ka luarei ka akais auni ka luonon.
Odwe luka Beker; Semira, ka Yoas, ka Elieser, ka Elioenai, ka Omiri, ka Yerimot, ka Abiya, ka Anatot, ka Alemet, Ŋul kere kes odwe luka Beker.
Aponi kimarai kaurikec, kwape ajaatar aturiokec, ikapolok luka ikekia luka lukapapaakec, ituŋa lukirigin luetitin, ilukumin akaisaarei ka akwat aarei.
Odwe luka Yediael; Bilikan: odwe luka Bilikan; Yeus, ka Benyamin, ka Ekud, ka Kenaana, ka Setan, ka Tarusis, ka Akisakar.
Ŋul kere kes odwe luka Yediael, kwape ajaatar ikapolok luka ikekia luka lukapapaakee, ituŋa lukirigin luetitiŋ, ilukumin itomon ka lukanykaarei ka akwat aarei, luapcdorete alosit kaiore oiie.
Supim da, ka Kupim, odwe luka Ir, Kusim, odwe luka Aker,
Odwe luka Naputali; Yasiel, ka Guni, ka Yeser, ka Salum, odwe luka Bilika.
Odwe luka Manase; Asuriel loaurikinit akeberu ŋes: (abu abusiatake naAramit kouri Makir papa loka Gilead:
Komany Makir aberu nako Kupim ka Supim, ekiror loka inacike ŋes Maaka); ekiror loka lokiareit Selopekad: ajaas Selopekad adwe.
Kouri Maaka aberu naka Makir okoku, komaik ekekiror Peres; ekiror loka onaceke Seres; odweke Ulam ka Rakem,
Odwe luka Ulam; Bedan, Ŋul kes odwe luka Gilead okoku loka Makir, okoku loka Manase.
Abu kinacike Kamolekat kouri Isikod, ka Abieser, ka Mala,
Odwe luka Semida kes Akian, ka Sekem, ka Liki, ka Aniam.
Odwe luka Epuralm; Sutela, ka Bered okokuke, ka Takat okokuke, ka Eleada okokuke, ka Takat okokuke,
ka Sabad okokuke, ka Sutela okokuke, ka Eser, ka Elead, luapotu ituŋa luka Gat luaurikinio kakwap koarata, naarai apo tu kojesaros ademar ibarenekec.
Kibworo Epuraim papakee apaarasia nuipu, kopotu ikeinacan aipudun ŋes,
Koloma mama ejai akeberu, kopotuu ŋesi, kouri ikoku, komaik ekekiror Beria, naarai ajaas karonis togokec,
Akokuke ŋes Seera, naabu koduk Bet-koron nakaiesa ka nakamukurat, ka Usen-seera,
Okokuke ŋes Repa, ka Resep, ka Tela okokuke, ka Takan okokuke;
Ladan okokuke, Amikud okokuke, Elisama okokuke;
Ikeceboro ka aiboisiokec kes Betel ka ireriake, Naaran kari nakokide, Geser, ka ireriake koto; Sekem da ka ireriake, kiton Asa ka ireriake:
Eiduny kiikoruno luka odwe luka Manase, Bet-sean ka ireriake, Taanak ka ireriake, Megido ka ireriake, Dor ka ireriake. Kiboikinos odwe luka Yosep okoku loka Isirael oreria ŋul.
Odwe luka Aser; Imina, ka Isiba, ka Isibi, ka Beria, ka Sera kinacikec,
Odwe luka Beria; Keber, ka Malukie!, lokerai papa loka Birisait.
Keber kouri Yapelet, ka Somer, ka Kotam, ka Sua kinacikee.
Odwe luka Yapelet; Pasak, ka Bimikal, ka Asubat. Ŋul kes odwe luka Yapelet.
Odwe luka Semer; Aki, ka Roga, ka Yekuba, ka Aram,
Odwe luka Kelem onaceke; Sopa, ka Imina, ka Seles, ka Ama!’
Odwe luka Sopa; Sua, ka Karuneper, ka Sual, ka Beri, ka Imira;
Beser, ka Kod, ka Sama, ka Silisa, ka Itiran, ka Beera.
Odwe luka Yeter; Yepune, ka Pisipa, ka Ara.
Odwe luka Ula; Ara, ka Kaniel, ka Risia.

Ŋul kere kes odwe luka Aser, ikapolok luka ikekia luka lukapapaakee, ituŋa lukeseunitai lukirigin Iuetitin, ikapolok luka ikapolok. Kimarai etiaikee kaurikee aijaanakin oiie emwaasi ituŋa ilukumin akaisaarei ka ilukumin ikanykape.
